verdict.rationale: There is no documented batch or bulk endpoint for Identity. Bulk work across many items is only implied: the secret-key API can create and read verification sessions programmatically, a flow's static link can verify any number of users, and the official CLI and MCP server could be used to script repeated calls. Missing for 10: a native batch/bulk API or dashboard bulk actions (e.g. bulk create, bulk override or bulk export of sessions), documentation of bulk workflows, and hands-on corroboration of bulk processing.
